column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- SnoRungs entries OUT of the published denominator BY LON'S WORD, one row each: name<TAB>CLASS<TAB>reason.
# The rung runner (test_corpus_snobol4.sh) passes these to the harness with ALL.outside.tsv (so they are not graded) and publishes
# pass / (shipped - EXCLUDED), naming EXCLUDED=N in the row and the SUITE TABLE's Excl column (util_score_row.py --excluded), the
# shape every SNOBOL4 package's EXCLUDED.tsv already has (CEO-1286). An EXCLUDED entry is NOT an expected failure: it carries no
# XFAIL marker and is not run; it returns to the denominator the day its row's cure lands. ceo CEO-1408, 2026-10-02.
